Kevin — thanks for the clarity and for the PO. Looping Ben (sales ops / billing) and Marissa (marketplace ops) to confirm the billing cadence and co-sell flow. Quick summary of what we can do and questions for your procurement team below.

Short answer: we can support monthly drawdowns via the GCP private offer path, but there are two caveats:
- Minimum monthly invoice threshold: we require a $X minimum per invoice to avoid very small monthly settlements (we can scope this in the SOW).
- Reconciliation cadence: we will do a quarterly usage reconciliation to true-up any over/under consumption against the annual commit.

Suggested operational plan (can be adjusted):
1) Execute private offer with monthly drawdown enabled.
2) OrbitCloud routes PO to Redwood procurement contact for DocuSign.
3) Redwood submits co-sell enablement packet to GCP (we handle partner claim setup).
4) Monthly invoicing against drawdown; quarterly reconciliation & adjustment.

Questions for OrbitCloud procurement: preferred invoice payer email and any internal billing reference you need included on invoices? Also, would you accept a small upfront partial drawdown in month 1 to cover ramp?

Ben / Marissa: can you confirm internal steps, and if there are any GCP partner forms we need from OrbitCloud to enable transactable co-sell claims?

Thanks — Hannah

Kevin / team — quick operational note from billing side.

We support monthly drawdown flows against an annual committed private offer. Typical Redwood setup:
- Monthly drawdown invoices are issued net-30 to the payer on the PO.
- We hold a quarterly reconciliation window where any shortfall is invoiced (or credited) to align with the annual commit.

If OrbitCloud needs strict monthly-only settlement (no quarterly true-up), we can discuss adjusting pricing or applying a buffer % to the monthly invoices to cover risk — often customers prefer that to avoid mid-year invoices.

I've attached our PO routing checklist that procurement will need to expedite (PO_Routing_Checklist.xlsx). Also please confirm:
- Invoice POC (name + email)
- GCP billing account id (if you want the commitment applied directly to a specific billing account)

I'll coordinate with finance to keep the cadence tight once we have the PO and payer info.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
